# Exact test-tool versions CI installs, applied to requirements.txt as a pip
# constraints file (pip install -c). This file exists so that a CI run is
# reproducible without changing requirements.txt, which deliberately states a
# floor (pytest>=7.4) rather than a pin: the engine, the CLI and the API are
# stdlib-only, so a contributor may use any pytest from 7.4 upward.
#
# A constraint narrows what pip may resolve; it never adds a package. So CI still
# installs exactly what requirements.txt asks for, at this version.
#
# This is the version the suite was last verified green against locally:
# 997 passed on Python 3.11.18.
pytest==9.2.0

# For reference, the rest of what that green run resolved (pytest's own transitive
# dependencies, left unpinned because they carry no test semantics of their own):
#   iniconfig==2.3.1  packaging==26.3  pluggy==1.7.0  Pygments==2.21.0
